BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 10-F in the area bounded by

The alley next north of and parallel to West 47th Street; South
Normal Avenue; West 47" Street; and a line 367 feet west of
and parallel to South Normal Avenue,

to those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 500-534 West 47" Street
